messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: Modification indicies
parts:
This problem was already discussed a few days ago:
https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/x-nnqMaMgIs

Use this code:
mb1<-'
PEM =~ pem9c+ pem10c+ pem12c
NEM =~ nem7c+ nem8c+ nem11c
N_A =~ panas2c+ panas3c+ panas4c+ panas8c+ panas10c
PA =~ panas1c+ panas5c+ panas6c+ panas7c+ panas9c
Fsexc =~ sexc
#PEM ~~ Fsexc
#NEM ~~ Fsexc
#N_A ~~ Fsexc
#PA ~~ Fsexc
'

You don't have to specify the covariances, the cfa function does that by
default.

Am 05.03.2021 um 00:03 schrieb Xiguang Liu:
> data<-read.csv("ArthAMOS listwise subsample 1.csv")
> data$pem9c<- data$ï..pem9c
> mb1<-'
> PEM =~ pem9c+ pem10c+ pem12c
> NEM =~ nem7c+ nem8c+ nem11c
> N_A =~ panas2c+ panas3c+ panas4c+ panas8c+ panas10c
> PA =~ panas1c+ panas5c+ panas6c+ panas7c+ panas9c
> PEM ~~ sexc
> NEM ~~ sexc
> N_A ~~ sexc
> PA ~~ sexc
> '
> model1<-cfa(mb1,data = data , std.lv = TRUE)
> summary(model1, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=T, modindices = TRUE)

CFA in AMOS vs. R: Different modification indices and standardized errors
